title: Extended APN aggregate maximum bit rate information element

fields.name: Extended APN aggregate maximum bit rate IEI
Length of extended APN aggregate maximum bit rate contents
Unit for extended APN-AMBR for downlink
Extended APN-AMBR for downlink (continued)
fields.description: Extended APN-AMBR for downlink value continuation

fields.name: Unit for extended APN-AMBR for uplink
Extended APN-AMBR for uplink (continued)
fields.description: Extended APN-AMBR for uplink value continuation

notes: Unit for extended APN-AMBR for downlink (octet 3) uses binary coding to indicate multiples from 4 Mbps to 256 Pbps
Octets 4 and 5 represent the binary coded value of extended APN-AMBR for downlink in units defined by octet 3
Unit for extended APN-AMBR for uplink (octet 6) coding is identical to that of the unit for extended APN-AMBR for downlink (octet 3)
Octets 7 and 8 represent the binary coded value of extended APN-AMBR for uplink in units defined by octet 6

NOTE: In this release of the specifications if received it shall be interpreted as value is incremented in multiples of 4 Mbps. In earlier releases of specifications, the interpretation of this value is up to implementation.
